notes: Root cause adopted from research: dispatch-worktree.sh cmd_provision()'s cp -al of .lake/ makes the five build-guard.* files one shared inode across trees. Hypotheses (a) and (b) ruled out; literal (d) refuted; '(d) amended' confirmed and reproduced. file_scope harvests to 4 files, including dispatch-worktree.sh which overlaps the separately-tracked land/release task.
